title: CLCON/182/2019 of PANKAJ KUMAR Vs RAJESH KUMAR

paras.text:
CLCON No. 182 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
 There is no representation for the
petitioner.
 Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for opposite
party.
 A coordinate Bench of this Court vide
order dated 27.03.2018 passed in Appeal
from Order Nos. 404 of 2013 and 92 of 2013
had dismissed the appeal filed by the insurer
under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act
with cost of ` 25,000/-.
 In this contempt petition, it is alleged
that the insurer has not deposited the cost
imposed by coordinate Bench of this Court.
 A reply affidavit alongwith application
has been filed on behalf of Mr. Rajesh
Kumar Sharma, Regional Manager, The
Oriental Insurance Company Limited. In
paragraph no. 5 of the application, it is
stated that on 16.04.2019, a demand draft
of ` 25,000/- was prepared, and sent to
concerned Branch.
 Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate appearing for
opposite party submits that the said bank
draft has been deposited with Motor
Accident Claims Tribunal, Champawat.
 Since, the amount of cost stands
deposited with the Motor Accident Claims
Tribunal, therefore, nothing survives in the
contempt petition.
Accordingly, the contempt petition is
dismissed. Contempt notice issued against
opposite party is discharged.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
Navin 01.05.2019
